description: This PHP class 'CriteriaInvestMatcherProcessor' extends 'AbstractMatcherProcessor' and manages the logic for matching investments based on customizable criteria such as minimum amount per project, number of donors, and donation percentage. It computes the amount to be matched for a given investment, considering current project and investor data.

classes.name: CriteriaInvestMatcherProcessor
classes.description: A processor class for matching investments based on configurable criteria such as minimum amount, number of donors, and donation percentage.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the amount to be matched based on various project and investor criteria, also handles error messaging if matcher funds are exhausted.
